Scrooge was a miserly old businessman who hated Christmas. His former business partner, Marley, had died seven years before, leaving Scrooge alone in the counting-house.

On Christmas Eve, the ghost of Jacob Marley visited Scrooge in his counting-house. Marley warned Scrooge that three more spirits would visit before dawn, each bringing a lesson the old man could not afford to ignore.

The Ghost of Christmas Past took Scrooge to revisit his lonely childhood. He saw himself as a young clerk under Mr. Fezziwig, where the season had been celebrated with warmth, dancing, and unstinting generosity.
